name: Edamame Egg Fried Rice with Vegetables

components.name: Edamame Egg Fried Rice
steps: Cook dry rice in measured water, then rapidly chill until cold. For meal prep, cook rice the previous day if following rigorous chilled-storage procedures.
Thaw edamame in the fridge and confirm product cooking requirements; cook it thoroughly as labelled.
Heat neutral oil in a large wok and scramble eggs until completely set; remove to a clean bowl.
Stir-fry carrot, broccoli, garlic and ginger until just tender, then add cold cooked rice and edamame.
Cook rice until steaming hot, stir in soy sauce, sesame oil, scallions and scrambled egg.
Portion into shallow containers and refrigerate quickly. Never leave cooked rice out on the counter to cool slowly.

Dietary: Soy, egg, sesame; cooked rice food-safety priority.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.

preservationAndReheating: Refrigerate cooked food promptly in shallow covered containers. Target within 2 hours, or within 1 hour if ambient temperatures exceed 32 C.
Refrigerate at 4 C or colder for up to 3-4 days; freeze later-week portions promptly. If freshly prepared salad is included, prepare and store separately.
Reheat previously cooked leftovers to 74 C, stirring and checking the centre. For egg dishes, ensure eggs are completely set before portioning.
Cool cooked rice rapidly and keep refrigerated; avoid leaving rice at room temperature. Reheat rice thoroughly once.
Defrost frozen portions in the refrigerator. Re-crisp pastries, breaded vegetables and air-fried items in an oven or air fryer.
Keep delicate avocado, fresh salad, cold yogurt sauce and unbaked crisp toppings separate. They are generally not freezer-friendly.
